evals.name: patch-bump-package-json
evals.prompt: Bump this project's version. The recent commits since the last bump are bug fixes only — apply a patch bump. Do NOT push or create a worktree (the fixture is not a real git repo). Just update the version files and CHANGELOG.md in place. Save the modified files to the outputs directory.
evals.expected_output: package.json's version goes from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1. CHANGELOG.md has a new entry for 1.0.1 dated today, with a 'Fixed' subsection summarizing the bug fix commits.
expectations: package.json contains the field `"version": "1.0.1"` after execution.
CHANGELOG.md contains a new heading line matching `## [1.0.1] - YYYY-MM-DD`.
The new 1.0.1 entry in CHANGELOG.md has a `### Fixed` subsection.
The original 1.0.0 entry remains in CHANGELOG.md, below the 1.0.1 entry.
The new 1.0.1 entry references at least one of the bug fixes from recent-commits.txt.
package.json is still valid JSON after modification.
No `### Added` or `### Improved` subsection appears in the new 1.0.1 entry (the commits were fixes only).
DISCRIMINATING: New CHANGELOG entry follows the exact 'Keep a Changelog' bracket-link format `## [1.0.1] - YYYY-MM-DD` (with literal brackets around the version).

evals.name: minor-bump-plugin-json
evals.prompt: Bump this Claude plugin's version. Commits since the last release include both new features and bug fixes — apply a minor bump. The plugin manifest is at `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`. Do not push or create worktrees; just update the version files and changelog. Save modified files to the outputs directory.
evals.expected_output: .claude-plugin/plugin.json's version is bumped from 1.5.2 to 1.6.0. CHANGELOG.md gains a new entry for 1.6.0 with both 'Added' and 'Fixed' subsections.
expectations: CHANGELOG.md contains a new heading line matching `## [1.6.0] - YYYY-MM-DD`.
The new 1.6.0 entry has a `### Added` subsection.
The new 1.6.0 entry has a `### Fixed` subsection.
.claude-plugin/plugin.json is still valid JSON after modification.
The CHANGELOG.md ordering preserves chronological history (1.6.0 entry above the previous 1.5.2 entry).
DISCRIMINATING: New CHANGELOG entry follows the exact 'Keep a Changelog' bracket-link format `## [1.6.0] - YYYY-MM-DD`.
